description: OpenSanctions 'default' collection full FollowTheMoney entity graph, scoped to sanctioned, PEP/RCA, POI, wanted, crime and export-control-linked entities plus every relationship touching them (ownership, directorship, family, associate, membership, employment, representation, succession, unknown links, position occupancy, sanction records) and their one-hop counterparties. acquisition.description: Latest default collection entities.ftm.json (FollowTheMoney JSON lines, ~2.6 GB; 307 redirect to a dated artifact; the artifact host ignored Range at probe time, so an interrupted download restarts). Re-acquire periodically; artifacts are immutable snapshots.
